records.title: CoRDE: Concept-Prior Routed Diffusion Experts for Structural Generalization in Robot Manipulation
records.reason: CoRDE routes diffusion experts for robot manipulation; its MoE is a robotics policy architecture, not LLM inference.

records.title: On the Expressive Power of Weight Quantization in Large Language Models
records.reason: This is theoretical work on expressive power under LLM weight quantization, directly adjacent to quantization lineage, but it does not propose a deployable optimization or empirical serving gain.

records.title: FBLayout: Optimizing Memory Layout for Efficient LLM Finetuning on Mobile GPUs
records.reason: FBLayout optimizes on-device LLM fine-tuning, which is training-only and outside inference scope.
